# Failures classified as upstream (not our setup). The DevLab ROCm workflows
# report a match as a warning instead of failing the job.
# Format: <fnmatch pattern on the test id> | <reason, one line> | <upstream issue URL, or "not filed">
# Test ids look like tests/ops/test_gdn.py::test_chunk[...]; a crashed or
# timed-out file is tests/ops/test_x.py::<exit N>.
